scripts.infra:up: docker compose up -d --wait db minio && docker compose run --rm minio_init
scripts.type-check: pnpm --dir apps/api type-check && pnpm --dir apps/admin type-check && pnpm --dir apps/app type-check
scripts.test:scripts: node --test scripts/*.test.cjs scripts/*.test.mjs scripts/native/*.test.cjs && python3 -B -m unittest discover -s scripts/native -p "test_*.py"
scripts.test: pnpm test:scripts && pnpm --dir apps/api test && pnpm --dir apps/admin test && pnpm --dir apps/app test
scripts.build: pnpm --dir apps/api build && pnpm --dir apps/admin build && pnpm --dir apps/app build:h5 && pnpm --dir apps/app build:mp-weixin
